title: Just ok.
text: Just ok.. These are just ok. I put 1 cup of flour in the 1 cup measuring cup and it bowed. The small measuring spoons have sharp edges. They store away nicely and the measurements are accurate. But, I would never order this again.

product_metadata.title: Measuring Cups and Spoons Set of 8 piece in 18/8 (304) Stainless Steel, Pan Shaped Measuring Cups and Narrow Measuring Spoons for Dry and Liquid Ingredients.
